title: Sumantra delivers the messages of Rama
introduction: As per the orders of king Dasaratha, Sumantra delivers the parting messages of Rama and Lakshmana. Rama sends positive messages to Kausalya and Bharata but Lakshmana sends angry messages to Dasaratha.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 58th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्याश्वस्तः यदा राजा मोहात् प्रत्यागतः पुनः |
थाजुहाव तम् सूतम् राम वृत्त अन्त कारणात्
verses.iast:
pratyāśvastaḥ yadā rājā mohāt pratyāgataḥ punaḥ |
thājuhāva tam sūtam rāma vṛtta anta kāraṇāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, the king when recovered from loss of consciousness and again returned to his breath, he called that charioteer for the purpose of getting the report on Rama.

glosses.meaning: for the purpose of getting the report on Rama.

verses.devanagari:
तदा सूतो महाराज कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः|
राममेव अनुशोचन्तं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम्
वृद्धम् परम सम्तप्तम् नव ग्रहम् इव द्विपम् |
विनिःश्वसन्तम् ध्यायन्तम् अस्वस्थम् इव कुन्जरम्
verses.iast:
tadā sūto mahārāja kṛtāJṇjalirupasthitaḥ |
rāmameva anuśocantaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam
vṛddham parama samtaptam nava graham iva dvipam |
viniḥśvasantam dhyāyantam asvastham iva kunjaram
verses.translation: Then, Sumantra, who joined his palms in reverence, approached the monarch who was repenting about Rama alone, filled with pain and sorrow, advanced in age, greatly anguished, sighing like a newly caught elephant and reflecting on something as a sick elephant.

glosses.meaning: who joined his palms in reverence

verses.devanagari:
राजा तु रजसा सूतम् ध्वस्त अङ्गम् समुपस्थितम् |
अश्रु पूर्ण मुखम् दीनम् उवाच परम आर्तवत्
verses.iast:
rājā tu rajasā sūtam dhvasta aṇ^gam samupasthitam |
aśru pūrṇa mukham dīnam uvāca parama ārtavat
verses.translation: The king, having great distress, spoke to Sumantra, whose body was covered with dust, his face filled with tears, who was miserable and who approached near him (as follows):

glosses.meaning: whose face was filled with tears

verses.devanagari:
क्व नु वत्स्यति धर्म आत्मा वृक्ष मूलम् उपाश्रितः |
सो अत्यन्त सुखितः सूत किम् अशिष्यति राघवः
verses.iast:
kva nu vatsyati dharma ātmā vṛkṣa mūlam upāśritaḥ |
so atyanta sukhitaḥ sūta kim aśiṣyati rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! Where can Rama the virtuous man abide, taking refuge at the root of a tree? What that Rama, who enjoyed very many pleasantries, can eat now?"

glosses.meaning: at the root of a tree? Kim = what

verses.devanagari:
दुःखस्यानुचितो दुःखम् सुमन्त्र शयनोचितः |
भूमि पाल आत्मजो भूमौ शेते कथम् अनाथवत्
verses.iast:
duḥkhasyānucito duḥkham sumantra śayanocitaḥ |
bhūmi pāla ātmajo bhūmau śete katham anāthavat
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! How can Rama the prince, who was habituated to good beds, sleep with such discomfort on a floor like an orphan?"

glosses.meaning: who was habituated to good beds

verses.devanagari:
यम् यान्तम् अनुयान्ति स्म पदाति रथ कुण्ज़्जराः |
स वत्स्यति कथम् रामः विजनम् वनम् आश्रितः
verses.iast:
yam yāntam anuyānti sma padāti ratha kuṇJjarāḥ |
sa vatsyati katham rāmaḥ vijanam vanam āśritaḥ
verses.translation: "Foot soldiers, Chariots and elephants used to follows whenever Rama was marching ahead. How such a man can take shelter and stay in a forest devoid of people?"

verses.devanagari:
व्याळैः मृगैः आचरितम् कृष्ण सर्प निषेवितम् |
कथम् कुमारौ वैदेह्या सार्धम् वनम् उपस्थितौ
verses.iast:
vyāLaiḥ mṛgaiḥ ācaritam kṛṣṇa sarpa niṣevitam |
katham kumārau vaidehyā sārdham vanam upasthitau
verses.translation: "How Seetha Rama and Lakshmana entered forest filled with wild animals and black snakes?"

verses.devanagari:
सुकुमार्या तपस्विन्या सुमन्त्र सह सीतया |
राज पुत्रौ कथम् पादैः अवरुह्य रथात् गतौ
verses.iast:
sukumāryā tapasvinyā sumantra saha sītayā |
rāja putrau katham pādaiḥ avaruhya rathāt gatau
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! How those princes with Seetha the delicate and the poor lady went on foot, after descending from the chariot?"

verses.devanagari:
सिद्ध अर्थः खलु सूत त्वम् येन दृष्टौ मम आत्मजौ |
वन अन्तम् प्रविशन्तौ ताव् अश्विनाव् इव मन्दरम्
verses.iast:
siddha arthaḥ khalu sūta tvam yena dṛṣṭau mama ātmajau |
vana antam praviśantau tāv aśvināv iva mandaram
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! You have seen my sons entering the forest, as though divinities of Aswini had entered the Mountain-range of Mandara. You are indeed lucky."

glosses.meaning: as (entering) the region of Mandara mountain
by the two divinities of Aswini

verses.devanagari:
किम् उवाच वचो रामः किम् उवाच च लक्ष्मणः |
सुमन्त्र वनम् आसाद्य किम् उवाच च मैथिली
verses.iast:
kim uvāca vaco rāmaḥ kim uvāca ca lakṣmaṇaḥ |
sumantra vanam āsādya kim uvāca ca maithilī
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! After reaching the forest, what words did Rama speak? What did Lakshmana speak? What did Seetha speak?"

verses.devanagari:
आसितम् शयितम् भुक्तम् सूत रामस्य कीर्तय |
जीविष्याम्यहमेतेन ययातिरिव साधुषु
verses.iast:
āsitam śayitam bhuktam sūta rāmasya kīrtaya |
jīviśhyāmyahametena yayātiriva sādhuṣu
verses.translation: "Oh, charioteer! Tell me where Rama sat, slept and took food. By hearing these things, I shall survive, as Yayati survived in the company of saints."
notes: Comment: King Yayati, when doomed to fall from heaven requested Indra to cast his lot with saints. He was accordingly sent down to a spot on the earth, where four ascetics- Astaka Pratardana, Vasuman and King Sibi had been practicing austerities, and had discourse with them- Mahabharata, Adi Parva.

verses.devanagari:
इति सूतः नर इन्द्रेण चोदितः सज्जमानया |
उवाच वाचा राजानम् स बाष्प परिर्बद्धया
verses.iast:
iti sūtaḥ nara indreṇa coditaḥ sajjamānayā |
uvāca vācā rājānam sa bāṣpa parirbaddhayā
verses.translation: As asked thus by the king, Sumantra spoke to the emperor in a voice quivering and choked with tears (as follows).

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीन् माम् महा राज धर्मम् एव अनुपालयन् |
अन्जलिम् राघवः कृत्वा शिरसा अभिप्रणम्य च
verses.iast:
abravīn mām mahā rāja dharmam eva anupālayan |
anjalim rāghavaḥ kṛtvā śirasā abhipraṇamya ca
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! Rama, keeping up the prescribed course of conduct, making salutation with joined palms and bowing his head in reverence to you, spoke to me as follows:"

verses.devanagari:
सूत मद्वचनात् तस्य तातस्य विदित आत्मनः |
शिरसा वन्दनीयस्य वन्द्यौ पादौ महात्मनः
verses.iast:
sūta madvacanāt tasya tātasya vidita ātmanaḥ |
śirasā vandanīyasya vandyau pādau mahātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, charioteer! Tell my salutations to my father, the one with a remarkable intellect, a mighty soul and the one to be respectfully greeted."

glosses.meaning: and one to be respectfully greeted

verses.devanagari:
सर्वम् अन्तः पुरम् वाच्यम् सूत मद्वचनात्त्वया |
आरोग्यम् अविशेषेण यथा अर्हम् च अभिवादनम्
verses.iast:
sarvam antaḥ puram vācyam sūta madvacanāttvayā |
ārogyam aviśeṣeṇa yathā arham ca abhivādanam
verses.translation: Oh, charioteer! Enquire about the health of all the people in the gynaeceum without any disparity and offer my appropriate salutations to them.

verses.devanagari:
माता च मम कौसल्या कुशलम् च अभिवादनम् |
अप्रमादम् च वक्तव्या ब्रूयाश्चैमिदम् वचः
verses.iast:
mātā ca mama kausalyā kuśalam ca abhivādanam |
apramādam ca vaktavyā brūyāścaimidam vacaḥ
verses.translation: My mother Kausalya is to be told about my welfare, about my offering salutations to her and about my meticulousness.

verses.devanagari:
धर्मनित्या यथाकालमग्न्यगारपरा भव |
देवि देवस्य पादौ च देववत् परिपालय
verses.iast:
dharmanityā yathākālamagnyagāraparā bhava |
devi devasya pādau ca devavat paripālaya
verses.translation: "Oh, godly lady! Be always righteous and be interested in offering worship and sacrifices as per the prescribed timings in the House of Fire worship. Nurture the feet of the Lord Dasaratha, like with a god."

glosses.meaning: and be interested in offering sacrifices in the house of fire-worship

verses.devanagari:
अभिमानम् च मानम् च त्यक्त्वा वर्तस्व मातृषु |
अनु राजान मार्याम् च कैकेयीमम्ब कारय
verses.iast:
abhimānam ca mānam ca tyaktvā vartasva mātṛṣu |
anu rājāna māryām ca kaikeyīmamba kāraya
verses.translation: "Oh, mother! Behave towards my other mothers, abandoning self-conceit and indignation. Make the venerable Kaikeyi, agreeable to the king."

verses.devanagari:
कुमारे भरते वृत्तिर्वर्तितव्याच राजवत् |
अर्थज्येष्ठा हि राजानो राजधर्ममनुस्मर
verses.iast:
kumāre bharate vṛttirvartitavyāca rājavat |
arthajyeṣṭhā hi rājāno rājadharmamanusmara
verses.translation: "In respect of Bharata your son, follow a respectable behaviour as with a king. Kings are indeed sovereign in substance. Remember the rules relating to kings."

verses.devanagari:
भरतः कुशलम् वाच्यो वाच्यो मद् वचनेन च |
सर्वास्व एव यथा न्यायम् वृत्तिम् वर्तस्व मातृषु
verses.iast:
bharataḥ kuśalam vācyo vācyo mad vacanena ca |
sarvāsva eva yathā nyāyam vṛttim vartasva mātṛṣu
verses.translation: "Bharata is to be enquired about his well-being and he is also to be informed as follows: "Follow good behaviour indeed judiciously towards all your mothers."

glosses.meaning: It is to be told also

verses.devanagari:
वक्तव्यः च महा बाहुर् इक्ष्वाकु कुल नन्दनः |
पितरम् यौवराज्यस्थो राज्यस्थम् अनुपालय
verses.iast:
vaktavyaḥ ca mahā bāhur ikṣvāku kula nandanaḥ |
pitaram yauvarājyastho rājyastham anupālaya
verses.translation: "The mighty armed Bharata the son of Ikshvaku race, is to be told as follows: �Being installed in the office of Prince Regent, attend to your father who still stays in the throne'."

glosses.meaning: is to be told (as follows) yauvaraajyasthaH = being installed in the office of prince Regent.

verses.devanagari:
अतिक्रान्तवया राजा मास्मैनम् व्यवरोरुधः |
कुमारराज्ये जीव त्वम् तस्यैवाज्ञ्प्रवर्तनाम्
verses.iast:
atikrāntavayā rājā māsmainam vyavarorudhaḥ |
kumārarājye jīva tvam tasyaivājJṇpravartanām
verses.translation: "The king has crossed his age. But do not depose him on that score. By proceeding according to the orders of the king, you live as a prince."

glosses.meaning: by proceeding according to the orders

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीच्चापि माम् भूयो भृशमश्रूणि वर्तयन् |
मातेव मम माता ते द्रष्टव्या पुत्रगर्धिनी
verses.iast:
abravīccāpi mām bhūyo bhṛśamaśrūṇi vartayan |
māteva mama mātā te draṣṭavyā putragardhinī
verses.translation: "Shedding tears profusely, Rama again spoke to me as follows : �My mother, who is very much longing her son, is to be looked after by you as if she is your mother'."

glosses.meaning: who is very much longing her son

verses.devanagari:
इति एवम् माम् महाराज बृवन्न् एव महा यशाः |
रामः राजीव ताम्र अक्षो भृशम् अश्रूणि अवर्तयत्
verses.iast:
iti evam mām mahārāja bṛvann eva mahā yaśāḥ |
rāmaḥ rājīva tāmra akṣo bhṛśam aśrūṇi avartayat
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! Rama of the most beautiful appearance with red eyes resembling red lotus flowers, while even uttering these words to me profusely shed tears."

glosses.meaning: with red eyes resembling red lotus flowers

verses.devanagari:
लक्ष्मणः तु सुसम्क्रुद्धो निह्श्वसन् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
केन अयम् अपराधेन राज पुत्रः विवासितः
verses.iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ tu susamkruddho nihśvasan vākyam abravīt |
kena ayam aparādhena rāja putraḥ vivāsitaḥ
verses.translation: "But Lakshmana was very angry and breathing a sigh, spoke to me as follows: �On which offence this prince was expelled from home?'"

verses.devanagari:
राज्ञा तु खलु कैकेय्या लघु त्वाश्रित्य शासनम् |
कृतम् कार्यमकार्यम् वा वयम् येनाभिपीडिताः
verses.iast:
rājJṇā tu khalu kaikeyyā laghu tvāśritya śāsanam |
kṛtam kāryamakāryam vā vayam yenābhipīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: "The king even took shelter under a wretched decree of Kaikeyi and performed an act not to be done, as though it is a proper deed, for which we are now tormented."

glosses.meaning: an act not to be done
as though it is a proper act

verses.devanagari:
यदि प्रव्राजितः रामः लोभ कारण कारितम् |
वर दान निमित्तम् वा सर्वथा दुष्कृतम् कृतम्
verses.iast:
yadi pravrājitaḥ rāmaḥ lobha kāraṇa kāritam |
vara dāna nimittam vā sarvathā duṣkṛtam kṛtam
verses.translation: "Even if this was done for the good pleasure of the king or through the will of God, I do not see any justification for Rama's abandonment."

glosses.meaning: or with the intention of giving boons

verses.devanagari:
इदम् तावद्यथाकाममीश्वरस्य कृते कृतम् |
रामस्य तु परित्यागे न हेतुम् उपलक्षये
verses.iast:
idam tāvadyathākāmamīśvarasya kṛte kṛtam |
rāmasya tu parityāge na hetum upalakṣaye
verses.translation: "Even if this was done for the good pleasure of the king or through the will of god, I do not see any justification for Rama's abandonment."

glosses.meaning: for the good pleasure of the kin
or through the will of god

verses.devanagari:
असमीक्ष्य समारब्धम् विरुद्धम् बुद्धि लाघवात् |
जनयिष्यति सम्क्रोशम् राघवस्य विवासनम्
verses.iast:
asamīkṣya samārabdham viruddham buddhi lāghavāt |
janayiṣyati samkrośam rāghavasya vivāsanam
verses.translation: "Rama's exile, an illegal decision undertaken whether due to levity of judgment or due to lack of reflection, will raise countless protests."

glosses.meaning: whether due to levity of judgment
or due to lack of reflection

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तावन् महा राजे पितृत्वम् न उपलक्षये |
भ्राता भर्ता च बन्धुः च पिता च मम राघवः
verses.iast:
aham tāvan mahā rāje pitṛtvam na upalakṣaye |
bhrātā bhartā ca bandhuḥ ca pitā ca mama rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: "I do not consider the emperor as my father. For me, Rama is the brother, lord, relative and my father."

verses.devanagari:
सर्व लोक प्रियम् त्यक्त्वा सर्व लोक हिते रतम् |
सर्व लोको अनुरज्येत कथम् त्वा अनेन कर्मणा
verses.iast:
sarva loka priyam tyaktvā sarva loka hite ratam |
sarva loko anurajyeta katham tvā anena karmaṇā
verses.translation: "Leaving Rama the beloved of all people and who is interested in the welfare of all human beings, how would all these people would be interested in you by this act of yours?"

glosses.meaning: in the welfare of all mankind

verses.devanagari:
सर्वप्रजाभिरामम् हि रामम् प्रव्राज्य धार्मिकम् |
सर्वलोकम् विरुध्येमम् कथम् राजा भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
sarvaprajābhirāmam hi rāmam pravrājya dhārmikam |
sarvalokam virudhyemam katham rājā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "By banishing Rama who is delightful to entire people and who is a virtuous man and by opposing all this entire world, how will you stay as a king?"

glosses.meaning: who is delightful to entire people

verses.devanagari:
जानकी तु महा राज निःश्वसन्ती तपस्विनी |
भूत उपहत चित्ता इव विष्ठिता वृष्मृता स्थिता
verses.iast:
jānakī tu mahā rāja niḥśvasantī tapasvinī |
bhūta upahata cittā iva viṣṭhitā vṛṣmṛtā sthitā
verses.translation: "Oh, King! The wise Seetha for her part with her mind like one possessed and forgetting her own existence, stood sighing and static.

verses.devanagari:
अदृष्ट पूर्व व्यसना राज पुत्री यशस्विनी |
तेन दुह्खेन रुदती न एव माम् किंचित् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
adṛṣṭa pūrva vyasanā rāja putrī yaśasvinī |
tena duhkhena rudatī na eva mām kiṃcit abravīt
verses.translation: "The illustrious Seetha having not seen such misfortune earlier, could not even to speak me anything, weeping as she was with that uneasiness."

glosses.meaning: having not seen such misfortune earlier

verses.devanagari:
उद्वीक्षमाणा भर्तारम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता |
मुमोच सहसा बाष्पम् माम् प्रयान्तम् उदीक्ष्य सा
verses.iast:
udvīkṣamāṇā bhartāram mukhena pariśuṣyatā |
mumoca sahasā bāṣpam mām prayāntam udīkṣya sā
verses.translation: "Seeing me going back, Seetha with emaciated face, perceiving her husband, soon shed down tears."

verses.devanagari:
तथैव रामः अश्रु मुखः कृत अन्जलिः |
स्थितः अभवल् लक्ष्मण बाहु पालितः स्थितः |
तथैव सीता रुदती तपस्विनी |
निरीक्षते राज रथम् तथैव माम्
verses.iast:
tathaiva rāmaḥ aśru mukhaḥ kṛta anjaliḥ |
sthitaḥ abhaval lakṣmaṇa bāhu pālitaḥ sthitaḥ |
tathaiva sītā rudatī tapasvinī |
nirīkṣate rāja ratham tathaiva mām
verses.translation: "In the same way, Rama with tears on his face and with joined palms, stood being shielded by the arms of Lakshmana. The miserable Seetha in the same manner was weeping and seeing the royal chariot and me."

glosses.meaning: shielded by the arms of Lakshmana
